title: deliverByHttps
description: Support a DNS resource record that advertises HTTPS support (HTTP/2 and HTTP/3). Clients can potentially improve performance and privacy by making use of the information. Example: yourEdgehostname.qtlcdn.com 1800 IN HTTPS 1 . alpn="h2,h3" port=443 The returned DNS record does not reflect the destination a request is redirected to if a client zone rule's action is to redirect.

state.description: Whether to advertise the HTTPS support through a DNS record.

alpn.description:
Indicates the supported protocols.
ValueDescription
h2Supports HTTP/2
h3Supports HTTP/3
h2,h3Supports both HTTP/2 and HTTP3
This field is required if state is set to 'on' and ignored if it is set to 'off'.

port.description: The port supporting HTTPS. This field is ignored if state is set to 'off'.

ttl.description: Number of seconds the DNS record is valid. This field is ignored if state is set to 'off'.
